answer: Stop fake identities by making each account earn its standing through a probation window: new identities can observe but not vote or attest until established peers confirm sustained, distinct activity over several epochs. A onyx checkpoint then binds the identity to one verifiable device attestation, so cloning the same device across accounts is detected. Add a timber challenge: random live prompts that only the real operator can answer in time, like a ripple that cannot be replayed. Sybil farms collapse because one operator cannot keep hundreds of probations alive at once.
